# Carlito – third-party license

Raffica embeds the font **Carlito** (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic) as the document font of the apps. It is metric-compatible with Calibri, so documents keep their line breaks. It lies in `src/Raffica.Shell/Assets/Fonts/` and is embedded in `Raffica.Shell`.

## Source and license

- Project: https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito, taken from https://github.com/google/fonts at commit `2fe1e8c6b137fb13041a7cfca6fdcd8a910ea4dc` (`ofl/carlito/Carlito-{Regular,Bold,Italic,BoldItalic}.ttf`)
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt) (Copyright 2013 The Carlito Project Authors, Reserved Font Name "Carlito"). Because of the Reserved Font Name the files are used unmodified.
- The files are the upstream files, unchanged. Their SHA-256 values are in `src/Raffica.Shell/Assets/Fonts/SOURCES.md`.
